name: Yoriko-san
source:
A girl who appears in the original work "Say Yah" as a college student who likes shotas. Four years passed and she reappears as an office worker. She is very excited to meet Tonakai for the first time in a long time.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=32990&gc=gcl]getchu[/url]]
